title: Ondagona Baa
desc: Raghu comes to his paternal village to attend his grandfather's diamond jubilee function. He finds out that due to his uncle, his family was separated, and tries to fix things.

title: Thavarina Theru
desc: Sridhar, an orphaned villager with a quiet heart, finds love in Shruti, but their path forward is tangled in her deep sense of duty towards her struggling family.

title: Bhanda Alla Bahaddur
desc: Following a misunderstanding, Krishna's grandfather throws him out of the house. His life takes a huge turn when he moves to the town and gets married to a rich girl.

title: Advocate
desc: Three girls who escape molestation but are charged with murder must prove their innocence with the help of a lawyer who is an alcoholic.

title: Varsha
desc: After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.
